short_description.text: Epaphroditus — Paul's fellow worker and fellow solder (PHP 2:25).
Euodia — Paul urged her to live in harmony in the Lord (PHP 4:2).
Syntyche — Paul urged her to live in harmony in the Lord (PHP 4:2).
Clement — a fellow worker of Paul's (PHP 4:3).
